dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's what you were talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: It may be because I pray to the Anemo Archon regularly... But I sensed bad tidings on the winds a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Maybe it was selfish of me only to pray for my husband's safety...

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Because now, all of Liyue's people need divine protection.
